name: plugin.semantic_cache
description: Similarity-based semantic cache for LLM prompts and agent task results

entrypoints.name: cache_set
entrypoints.description: Store a prompt and response in the semantic cache with optional TTL

entrypoints.name: cache_get
entrypoints.description: Retrieve cached response based on prompt token similarity threshold

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Prompt query to match against cached entries

parameters.name: similarity_threshold
parameters.description: Minimum similarity score required for cache hit (0.0 to 1.0, default 0.90)

entrypoints.name: cache_stats
entrypoints.description: Get current cache metrics including hits, misses, and hit rate
